schema._comment: The experiment variables the editor + owner test per video VERSION. Extracted from the 2026-06-24 editor meeting. Drives the dashboard input form (2_dashboards/Video_Dashboard.html) and the experiment registry. Two main levers: FIRST FRAME (swipe) and HOOK/words (AVD).

fields.label: Short / product name
fields.help: Groups all versions of the same short together

fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: What changed vs the last version, hypothesis…

groups.label: First Frame — drives SWIPE
groups.help: The single most important thing: what stops the scroll in the first ~1s. Tune these BEFORE the script.

groups.label: Hook / Words — drives AVD
groups.help: Secondary lever (the swipe is too fast to hear words). Words affect watch-through. KEY rule from testing: open with a STATEMENT, not a question.

fields.label: Opening line type
options: statement that sounds like a question

fields.label: Contradicts common belief
fields.help: e.g. 'I thought this was indestructible, but it's not'

fields.label: Recorded with mic from the start
